name: Vincâ
notes: Panel uses only I/O icons; names from manual key. IN 1B normalled to +5V; CV 2 (channel 2 CV input) normalled to +5V and half-wave rectified. OUT 1 normals into channel 2 per Mode switch (parallel = summed at OUT 2, series = into IN 2). Rear IN/OUT 'back jacks' for chaining vincâs are on the PCB, not the front panel, so excluded.
